Class HighScoreManager

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.filehandler.HighScoreManager
public class HighScoreManager extends Object
This class handles calculations, writing and reading of highscores. Usually invoked when checking highscores or when finishing a game to get highscores.

Gets week and sale-calculations from Exchange and money-related and portfolio states from Player

  • Method Details

    • calculateFinalScore

      public static BigDecimal calculateFinalScore(Exchange exchange, Player player)
      Calculates the final score for a given game state.

      Formula: Difficulty * Week * (NetWorth / StartingMoney) * 10. Higher weeks and a greater profit margin yield a higher score.

      Parameters:
      exchange - the exchange at the point of scoring
      player - the player whose state is scored
      Returns:
      the calculated final score
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the score turns out negative

    • addFinalScoreToCsv

      public static boolean addFinalScoreToCsv(Exchange exchange, Player player)
      Appends a new high-score entry to the CSV file.

      Format of each line: week,playerName,finalScore

      Parameters:
      exchange - the exchange at the point of scoring
      player - the player whose score is recorded
      Returns:
      true if the entry was written successfully, false otherwise

    • getHighScores

      public static List<List<String>> getHighScores()
      Reads all high scores from the CSV and returns them sorted by final score descending.

      Each entry is a List<String> with three elements:

      1. week (e.g. "12")
      2. player name (e.g. "Alice")
      3. final score (e.g. "340.50")
      Returns:
      entries sorted by score descending; empty list if the file is missing or unreadable
